newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASSIDOMAN UP ON S-E-BANKEN UPGRADE.
newsitem.headline: ASSIDOMAN UP ON S-E-BANKEN UPGRADE.

text.p: Shares in Swedish forestry company AssiDoman rose after Swedish bank Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken upgraded its recommendation on the share to 'buy' from 'outperform'.
At 0930 GMT the share was trading up seven crowns at 247 compared to 242 crowns just after market open. The share added 1.5 crowns to its price when the S-E-Banken recommendation was published.
AssiDoman released a higher than expected six-month profit a day earlier and closed seven crowns higher on the day, helped also by gains in U.S. forestry shares overnight.
S-E-Banken Karl-Johan Krigstrom told Reuters he upgraded his earnings forecast on the share for 1998 and 1999.
"In the past three months we have been aggressive buyers of forestry shares and AssiDoman is the Swedish company we consider the most interesting in the long- and short-term," Krigstrom said.
